content.title: Validate standardized E2E runner docs + bunx caveat
content.description:
Validate the Dev task output for the ACCEPTED CTO decision (review mqgvczj5ua / idea mqe32t3er6). Verify:

1. webapp-developer expertise files (webapp-overview.expertise.md, recipe-validate-webapp-phase.md, webapp-e2e-validation.expertise.md) consistently use `cd packages/webapp && npx playwright test` — no stale `bunx playwright test` references remain as THE recommended command.
2. The bunx-caveat gotcha text is present and accurate in both webapp-validator-gotchas.md and webapp-developer/webapp-overview.expertise.md.
3. If a `test:e2e` script was added to packages/webapp/package.json, it is correct and discoverable.
4. Confirm NO test/source-code logic was changed (this is docs/tooling-only).
5. Optionally confirm `npx playwright test --list` loads the suite cleanly from packages/webapp.

Reproduce/diagnose only — do NOT fix. Report findings via comment. If valid, mark done.
